build_system: Shopify CLI (shopify theme dev/check), no build step required - static files served directly
test_framework: Shopify CLI theme check (shopify theme check) for linting and validation
build_command: No build required - Shopify themes are static files
test_command: shopify theme check (requires Shopify CLI installed) OR manual JSON validation
verification_instructions: 1. Validate all JSON files with a JSON parser. 2. Ensure theme.liquid exists in layout/. 3. Verify all templates reference existing sections. 4. Check settings_schema.json is valid array. 5. Theme should be zippable and uploadable to Shopify admin.
environment_constraints: Workspace is c:\xampp\htdocs\shopify. All files must be created here. Theme must follow exact Shopify directory structure with no nested subdirectories beyond /templates/customers/.
contribution_requirements: All JSON must be valid. All Liquid syntax must be correct. Section schemas must define proper settings and blocks. Settings_data.json must provide sample values for preview.
key_patterns: Shopify 2.0 uses JSON templates that reference sections. Sections have {% schema %} tags with settings/blocks. Snippets are reusable Liquid partials rendered with {% render %}. Assets are referenced with {{ 'file.css' | asset_url }}. Settings accessed via {{ settings.setting_id }} globally or {{ section.settings.id }} in sections.
relevant_files: sections/*.liquid - customizable section files with schemas
directory_structure:
Required Shopify theme structure:
/assets - CSS, JS, images (flat, no subdirs)
/config - settings_schema.json, settings_data.json
/layout - theme.liquid (required), plus optional layouts
/locales - en.default.json and other locale files
/sections - all section .liquid files
/snippets - reusable .liquid partials
/templates - JSON templates for pages
/templates/customers - customer account templates
